name: cabinet-v3-prototype
description: Pure layout modules (treemap/circlepack) are DOM-free by design so they can run under Node for testing, same rationale as fffx-subdivision.js. index.html is now build-time precompute (v3.6.2, see build-static.mjs) -- the DOM-free design is also what let that ship as a headless-browser snapshot rather than a hand-written serializer.
